meaningTerms.ja: 秘密を漏らす。

usage: English source expression: disclose information meant to remain secret. Informal; can be deliberate or accidental. Literal beans belong only to the wording guide.

meaningTerms.ja: 気まずい失敗をする。

literalTerms.es: Meter la pata.

usage: Spanish source expression: a social blunder or ill-timed mistake. Informal; not a literal instruction about an animal's paw.

terms.es: Estar entre la espada y la pared.

meaningTerms.fr: Être coincé entre deux choix difficiles.
meaningTerms.ja: 難しい二つの選択肢の間で困る。

literalTerms.en: Be between the sword and the wall.
literalTerms.es: Estar entre la espada y la pared.
literalTerms.fr: Être entre l'épée et le mur.
literalTerms.de: Zwischen dem Schwert und der Wand sein.
literalTerms.it: Essere fra la spada e il muro.
literalTerms.pt: Estar entre a espada e a parede.

usage: Spanish source expression: feel cornered with no easy option. It may describe pressure, not necessarily a freely chosen pair of alternatives.

terms.fr: Coûter les yeux de la tête.
terms.ja: 非常に高価である。

meaningTerms.fr: Être très cher.
meaningTerms.ja: 非常に高価である。

literalTerms.en: Cost the eyes from one's head.
literalTerms.es: Costar los ojos de la cabeza.
literalTerms.fr: Coûter les yeux de la tête.
literalTerms.zh-CN: 贵到要付出头上的眼睛。
literalTerms.de: Die Augen aus dem Kopf kosten.
literalTerms.ja: 頭の目を代価として払うほどかかる。

usage: French source expression: an exaggerated complaint about a very high price. Informal. The eyes are imagery, not a literal payment.

terms.en: Fail to show up for an arranged meeting.

meaningTerms.ja: 約束した待ち合わせに来ない。

literalTerms.es: Poner un conejo.

usage: French source expression: leave someone waiting by not attending an agreed meeting. Informal; dates and other appointments both qualify. It is not the English physical action 'stand up'.

terms.en: Patience helps you get through hardship.
terms.es: La paciencia ayuda a superar las dificultades.

literalTerms.en: Patience is the key to relief.
literalTerms.es: La paciencia es la llave del alivio.
literalTerms.fr: La patience est la clé du soulagement.
literalTerms.de: Geduld ist der Schlüssel zur Erleichterung.
literalTerms.it: La pazienza è la chiave del sollievo.
literalTerms.ja: 忍耐は安堵への鍵である。
literalTerms.pt: A paciência é a chave do alívio.

usage: A common Arabic proverb about endurance through difficulty. It offers encouragement, not a guarantee that waiting alone will solve a problem.

terms.fr: Il est revenu sans rien obtenir.

terms.ja: 彼は何も得ずに戻った。

meaningTerms.tr: Hiçbir şey elde etmeden geri döndü.

literalTerms.en: He returned with Hunayn's two slippers.
literalTerms.es: Volvió con las dos zapatillas de Hunayn.
literalTerms.fr: Il est revenu avec les deux pantoufles de Hunayn.
literalTerms.zh-CN: 他带着侯奈因的两只拖鞋回来了。
literalTerms.ru: Он вернулся с двумя туфлями Хунайна.
literalTerms.de: Er kam mit Hunayns beiden Pantoffeln zurück.
literalTerms.it: È tornato con le due pantofole di Hunayn.
literalTerms.ja: 彼はフナインの二つの履物を持って戻った。
literalTerms.ko: 그는 후나인의 신발 두 짝을 가지고 돌아왔다.
literalTerms.pt: Voltou com os dois chinelos de Hunayn.

usage: Arabic expression about returning empty-handed after an unsuccessful effort. Hunayn is part of the conventional wording. The displayed form is third-person masculine; adapt it to the speaker and context.

terms.en: Spoil something by adding unnecessary details.
terms.fr: Gâcher quelque chose par des ajouts inutiles.
terms.ar: يفسد شيئا بإضافة تفاصيل غير ضرورية.
terms.ja: 余計なものを加えて台無しにする。

meaningTerms.en: Spoil something by adding unnecessary details.

meaningTerms.zh-CN: 添加不必要的东西，反而弄巧成拙。
meaningTerms.ja: 余計なものを加えて台無しにする。
meaningTerms.tr: Gereksiz ayrıntılar ekleyerek bir şeyi bozmak.

literalTerms.en: Draw a snake and add feet.
literalTerms.es: Dibujar una serpiente y añadirle patas.
literalTerms.fr: Dessiner un serpent et lui ajouter des pattes.
literalTerms.zh-CN: 画一条蛇，再给它添上脚。
literalTerms.ru: Нарисовать змею и добавить ей ноги.
literalTerms.de: Eine Schlange zeichnen und Füße hinzufügen.
literalTerms.it: Disegnare un serpente e aggiungergli le zampe.
literalTerms.ja: 蛇を描いて足を付け加える。
literalTerms.pt: Desenhar uma cobra e acrescentar patas.

usage: Chinese four-character expression for an unnecessary addition that makes an otherwise adequate result worse. It is criticism, not praise for extra effort.

terms.en: After a loss, it is still worth fixing the problem.
terms.es: Tras una pérdida, aún vale la pena corregir el problema.
terms.fr: Après une perte, il est encore utile de corriger le problème.
terms.ar: بعد الخسارة لا يزال إصلاح المشكلة مفيدا.
terms.ru: После потери ещё не поздно исправить проблему.
terms.de: Nach einem Verlust lohnt es sich noch, das Problem zu beheben.
terms.it: Dopo una perdita vale ancora la pena risolvere il problema.
terms.ja: 損失の後でも問題を直す価値はある。
terms.ko: 손해를 본 뒤라도 문제를 고칠 가치는 있다.
terms.pt: Depois de uma perda, ainda vale a pena corrigir o problema.
terms.tr: Bir kayıptan sonra da sorunu düzeltmeye değer.

literalTerms.en: Mend the pen after losing sheep.
literalTerms.es: Reparar el corral después de perder ovejas.
literalTerms.fr: Réparer l'enclos après avoir perdu des moutons.
literalTerms.de: Den Pferch nach dem Verlust von Schafen ausbessern.
literalTerms.it: Riparare il recinto dopo aver perso le pecore.
literalTerms.ja: 羊を失ってから囲いを直す。
literalTerms.pt: Consertar o curral depois de perder ovelhas.

usage: Chinese proverb: a setback can still be followed by useful corrective action. Unlike some 'too late' proverbs, it need not imply that repair is pointless.

terms.fr: Exagérer un petit problème.
terms.ja: 小さな問題を大げさにする。

meaningTerms.fr: Exagérer un petit problème.
meaningTerms.ja: 小さな問題を大げさにする。

literalTerms.en: Make an elephant out of a fly.
literalTerms.es: Hacer un elefante de una mosca.
literalTerms.de: Aus einer Fliege einen Elefanten machen.
literalTerms.it: Fare un elefante da una mosca.
literalTerms.pt: Fazer um elefante de uma mosca.

usage: Russian expression for making a small difficulty seem much larger. Informal and potentially dismissive of another person's concerns.

terms.es: Engañar a alguien con historias inventadas.

terms.ja: 作り話で人をだます。

meaningTerms.es: Engañar a alguien con historias inventadas.
meaningTerms.fr: Tromper quelqu'un avec des histoires inventées.
meaningTerms.ja: 作り話で人をだます。

literalTerms.es: Colgar fideos de las orejas de alguien.
literalTerms.fr: Accrocher des nouilles aux oreilles de quelqu'un.
literalTerms.zh-CN: 把面条挂在别人的耳朵上。
literalTerms.de: Jemandem Nudeln an die Ohren hängen.
literalTerms.it: Appendere spaghetti alle orecchie di qualcuno.
literalTerms.pt: Pendurar macarrão nas orelhas de alguém.

usage: Russian informal expression for deceiving or misleading someone with stories. It can sound accusatory; do not use it as a neutral synonym for explaining.

terms.fr: Souhaiter bonne chance à quelqu'un.
terms.ja: 誰かの幸運を祈る。

meaningTerms.fr: Souhaiter bonne chance à quelqu'un.
meaningTerms.ja: 誰かの幸運を祈る。

literalTerms.es: Apretar los pulgares.

usage: German expression for hoping things go well for someone. A usual sentence is 'Ich drücke dir die Daumen.' The image is different from English crossed fingers.

terms.es: No darse cuenta de algo evidente.

terms.zh-CN: 没有注意到显而易见的事。

meaningTerms.ja: 明らかなことに気づかない。

literalTerms.es: Tener tomates sobre los ojos.
literalTerms.fr: Avoir des tomates sur les yeux.
literalTerms.ja: 目の上にトマトがある。

usage: German informal teasing or criticism when someone overlooks the obvious. It can sound rude; it does not describe an eye condition.

terms.fr: Ne plus avoir d'argent.
terms.ja: お金がなくなる。

meaningTerms.fr: Ne plus avoir d'argent.
meaningTerms.ja: お金がなくなる。

literalTerms.es: Estar en el verde.

usage: Italian informal expression for being broke. Do not confuse the green imagery with a positive bank balance or environmental claims.

terms.fr: Dépenser sans compter.
terms.ja: 無計画にお金を使う。

meaningTerms.fr: Dépenser sans compter.
meaningTerms.ja: 無計画にお金を使う。

literalTerms.es: Tener las manos agujereadas.

usage: Italian expression for being a spendthrift. It is critical rather than simply describing generosity.

terms.es: Preferir lo práctico a las apariencias.
terms.fr: Préférer l'utile aux apparences.
terms.de: Praktischen Nutzen dem schönen Schein vorziehen.

meaningTerms.es: Preferir lo práctico a las apariencias.

meaningTerms.de: Praktischen Nutzen dem schönen Schein vorziehen.
meaningTerms.ja: 見た目より実用を重視する。

literalTerms.es: Bolas de masa antes que flores.
literalTerms.fr: Des boulettes plutôt que des fleurs.

usage: Japanese proverb contrasting practical satisfaction with aesthetics. Dango are the dumplings in the literal image; translated food names are explanatory approximations, not exact culinary equivalents.

terms.fr: Même les experts font des erreurs.
terms.ja: 猿も木から落ちる

meaningTerms.fr: Même les experts font des erreurs.
meaningTerms.ja: 上手な人でも失敗する。

literalTerms.es: Hasta los monos se caen de los árboles.
literalTerms.fr: Même les singes tombent des arbres.
literalTerms.zh-CN: 猴子也会从树上掉下来。
literalTerms.it: Anche le scimmie cadono dagli alberi.
literalTerms.pt: Até os macacos caem das árvores.

usage: Japanese proverb acknowledging that skilled people also make mistakes. It may reassure someone after a slip; avoid turning it into ridicule.

terms.fr: Connaître beaucoup de monde.
terms.ja: 知り合いが多い。

meaningTerms.fr: Connaître beaucoup de monde.
meaningTerms.ja: 知り合いが多い。

literalTerms.es: Tener los pies anchos.

usage: Korean idiom for having many acquaintances and social connections, not the physical width of feet. A polite conversational form is 발이 넓어요.

terms.en: Be generous with food or gifts.

terms.ja: 食べ物や贈り物を気前よく出す。

usage: Korean idiom often used for someone who prepares large amounts of food or gives generously. It can also suggest doing things on a large scale. It is not the same as the critical Italian expression about wasteful spending.

terms.fr: C'est enfin devenu clair.
terms.ja: ようやく分かった。

meaningTerms.fr: C'est enfin devenu clair.
meaningTerms.ja: ようやく分かった。

literalTerms.es: La ficha cayó.

usage: Informal Brazilian Portuguese: understanding finally dawned, often after a delay. The idiom can be conjugated; cair a ficha is its dictionary form.

terms.es: Pagar por el error de otra persona.

literalTerms.es: Pagar el pato.

usage: Portuguese informal expression for taking the blame or suffering consequences, often for another person's mistake. The natural translation avoids suggesting an actual purchase of a bird.

terms.en: Small contributions add up over time.

literalTerms.es: Gota a gota se forma un lago.
literalTerms.fr: Goutte à goutte, un lac se forme.
literalTerms.de: Tropfen für Tropfen entsteht ein See.
literalTerms.it: Goccia a goccia si forma un lago.
literalTerms.ja: 一滴ずつで湖ができる。
literalTerms.pt: Gota a gota, forma-se um lago.

usage: Turkish proverb about small amounts accumulating, often in saving or steady effort. It expresses encouragement, not a promised rate of learning or financial return.

terms.fr: Exagérer un petit problème.

meaningTerms.fr: Exagérer un petit problème.
meaningTerms.ja: 些細なことを大げさにする。

literalTerms.de: Aus einem Floh ein Kamel machen.

usage: Turkish expression for making a minor issue seem much larger. Like the Russian fly-and-elephant expression, it can sound dismissive when directed at someone's concerns.
